item.title: 8 years later: Did God of War deserve to beat Red Dead Redemption 2 for the TGA GOTY 2018?
item.author: invalid@example.com (Genetrik)
item.dc:creator: Genetrik
item.content:encoded: Today marks exactly 8 years since Red Dead Redemption 2 launched, and it got me thinking about one of the most memorable Game of the Year races at The Game Awards. Back in 2018, God of War took home the biggest award, beating Red Dead Redemption 2. At the time, I agreed with that decision. I thought God of War was the better game and a deserving winner. But eight years later, I've changed my mind. Looking back, I increasingly feel that Red Dead Redemption 2 was the more extraordinary... Read more
